svg.title: Hi, I'm Aksh Rastogi
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Aksh Rastogi. I build applied AI products, end to end. Co-founder & CTO at MAITRI, an adaptive AI wellness companion that reads mood, voice, posture and heart rate. Lead engineer on OASIS, a studio for AI video and music generation. Studying CS (AI & ML) at Delhi Technical Campus, GGSIPU, New Delhi. PyTorch and llama.cpp for models, FastAPI and React to ship them. chickenwings.in Background: a contour map of the last 52 weeks of GitHub activity to 2026-11-22. Time runs left to right, each ridge is a repository, height is contributions per week on a log scale.
